# Instructions for accurately documenting failed advertised specifications in a consumer product performance report

1. Start with the test records.

completion:
Accurately identify the product and its advertised specifications.
3. Document each testing method and equipment used.
4. Record the test environment conditions.
5. Clearly articulate the advertised specifications that were tested.
6. Include pre-test predictions if available.
7. Perform several iterations of the tests to ensure consistency.
8. Note any anomalies or unexpected behavior observed during testing.
9. Use precise measurements and provide quantifiable data.
10. Compare the actual performance of the product to its advertised specifications.
11. Highlight areas where the product failed to meet the advertised specifications.
12. Use clear, concise language to describe test results.
13. Provide an explanation for the failed test results if possible.
14. Include visual evidence such as graphs, charts, or images to support the claims.
15. Ensure the report is well-organized and easy to follow.
